title: WorkflowInput
description: Standardized context-gathering inputs required across YouTube workflows

channel_niche.description: Specific niche (e.g., 'budget Android phone reviews' rather than generic 'tech')

channel_url_or_handle.description: Required for channel-audit, analytics-analysis, and competitor-analysis

target_video_topic.description: Topic or target keyword for video-specific workflows

video_transcript.description: Raw text or subtitle transcript of video
